---
template: 'Bug Fix'
about: A PR that fixes a bug or issue
title: 'Bug Fix (#[ISSUE-ID]) [OVERVIEW]'
labels: 'bug'
assignees: NineOfGaming
---

## Summary

Describe the bug and the change that fixes it.

## Root cause

Explain what was wrong and why the bug happened.

## Verification

List the checks you ran, or explain why you could not run them.

- [ ] I tested the fix locally
- [ ] I could not run local verification and explained why below
- [ ] The change is scoped to the bug being fixed
- [ ] User-facing text, config labels, or docs were updated if needed
- [ ] I added or updated tests where practical

## Additional context

Add screenshots, logs, recordings, or anything else that would help reviewers validate the change.

## Issue

Closes #

## Notes for review

Call out anything reviewers should pay attention to, including edge cases, compatibility concerns, or follow-up work.
